items.title: 19.2 DNA as the hereditary material (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the search for the hereditary material (PDF 119).

blocks.text: Jab yeh tay ho gaya ke genes virasat ki ikaiyan hain, genes chromosomes par hain, aur chromosomes DNA aur proteins se bane hain, to sciencedanon ne yeh jaanna chaha ke genes DNA se bane hain, protein se ya dono se. Is sawal ka jawab dhoondne mein taqreeban 30 saal, 1920s se 1950s tak, lage.

blocks.title: Maloomat: genetic maadde ko kya karna chahiye
blocks.text: Genetic maadda banne wala molecule proteins mein amino acids ki tarteeb ka code de sake, cell taqseem se pehle apni copy bana sake, eukaryotic cells ke nucleus mein maujood ho, aur evolution ke liye waqt ke saath badal sake. Sirf aik molecule, DNA, yeh sab sharaait poori karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Genetic maadde ki do khasiyatein batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: proteins ke amino acids ki tarteeb ka code; taqseem se pehle replication; eukaryotic nucleus mein maujoodgi; waqt ke saath badalne ki salahiyat.

items: 1920s-1950s ka sawal: genes DNA hain, protein ya dono?
Genetic maadda code de, replicate ho, nucleus mein ho aur badal sake.
